info.title: ElDokan Customer API
info.description: Frozen Customer API adapter 0.8.0, Contract v1. Native credentialed customer cookies; Guest Cart sessions; header-only Guest Order capability. All responses private, no-store. Checkout and payment HTTP 200 can contain issues; browser return is not payment proof. Real staging acceptance remains required. Adapter 0.9.0 adds moderated verified-purchase reviews, seller reviews, paginated seller products and category best sellers. Adapter 0.10.0 adds password recovery, customer returns, product alerts, saved decision profiles, review images and feedback, diagnostics and catalog sitemap. Bosta integration is deferred.

post.description: All decorated responses are private, no-store. JSON mutations only.  Authenticated native Woo customer owner OR exact Guest Order capability; missing/foreign/invalid credential all 404. Staff/seller excluded. A customer can retain a Guest capability without account attachment. Dedicated Guest CSRF when capability authorizes payment; account CSRF when customer owner authorizes payment.  Phase 2C mapped Orders only. Browser return is not payment confirmation; status comes from authoritative Woo.  Recover with {}. Deliberate retry uses current generation on the SAME Order. No provider request from the client.

CustomerSession.name: wordpress_logged_in_[site-hash]
CustomerSession.description: WordPress-native Secure/HttpOnly customer session cookie. The concrete cookie name is site-specific and is managed by the browser, never frontend JavaScript.

GuestCartSession.name: eldokan_guest_cart
GuestCartSession.description: Opaque Secure/HttpOnly guest Cart ownership cookie. Its value is never exposed to frontend JavaScript or response bodies.

CsrfToken.name: X-ElDokan-CSRF
CsrfToken.description: X-ElDokan-CSRF from current customer/Cart session for those mutations; dedicated guest_access.csrf_token for Guest Order payment. X-WP-Nonce is a previously accepted native REST transport; this API advertises session CSRF.

GuestOrderAccess.name: X-ElDokan-Order-Access
GuestOrderAccess.description: Header-only exact Guest Order capability. Does not authorize Order list or attach Orders to accounts.
